name: Sika Showerbond
paste:
SIKA® SHOWERBOND: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Showerbond, January 2025, Version 05.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sika_showerbond.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Showerbond where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 05.01).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Showerbond is a solvent based, fast grab, gun grade adhesive. It has been specifically formulated for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to unpainted gypsum plasterboard, fibre cement sheeting and timber.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Showerbond is used for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to suitable wall linings and bonding acrylic shower trays to suitable flooring.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Showerbond
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: SOLVENT BASED GUN GRADE WALLBOARD ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (January 2025, Version 05.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fast curing
    - Will not damage acrylic plastic shower liners
    - Panels can be relocated for up to 30 minutes after positioning
    - Excellent adhesion to most common building materials
    - Easy to apply and clean up
    - Recommended and used by leading acrylic fixture manufacturers
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: Green
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Solid content by mass: ~ 65%
    - Movement capability: Movement accommodation is slight, will accept normal building movement
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 300ml cartridges, box of 20
    - Shelf life: Eighteen (18) months when stored as stated.
    - Storage conditions: Store in original unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from naked flames.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Ensure both surfaces to be bonded are clean, dry and grease free. Cut nozzle on cartridge as shown below so that a 5-6 mm bead will be extruded.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2025, Version 05.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Yield: On average, one cartridge of Sika® Showerbond will supply approx. 12 metres of 5mm x 5mm bead
    - Curing rate: ~ 24 hours @ 20°C
    - Skinning time: 1 minute
4.3 Application method / tools.
    - Relocation time: Up to 30 minutes, depending on temperature and ventilation
    - Apply a 5-6 mm bead in vertical lines at 100 mm centres onto substrate, and apply continuous bead within 15 mm of the perimeter line of the shower lining.
    - Place shower lining onto wall within 10 minutes and firmly press the entire sheet with your hands so that full contact is made with all beads of adhesive.
    - Brace the lining as required in the shower manufacturer's installation instructions.
    - Bracing if required should remain in position for not less than 18 hours. The shower should not be used for at least 24 hours after the wall lining has been installed.
    - Do not apply blobs of adhesive. These will cause unsightly undulations and buckles in the sheet.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Clean up using a dry clean cloth or Sika® Remover-208.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Not recommended for immersion, exposure to sunlight or exterior use
    - Do not use below 5°C
    - Do not use to adhere acrylic plastic shower linings to painted, sealed or any non-porous wall linings
    - Cure is by solvent release (flammable solvents are released during cure)

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. Application temperature: +5°C to +35°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - Do not use below 5°C
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Showerbond, January 2025, Version 05.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/sika_showerbond.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® Showerbond, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sds-sika-showerbond.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
